analysis: Only docs/provider/cli-reference.md changed. The supplied BASE excerpts cover lines 386-1226, including the `darkbloom update` section at 737-749. The patch excerpt is truncated and the HEAD text is not supplied, so I could not verify the head-side additions (`--rollback`, `--yes`, quarantine and override semantics, and the new rollback description at head lines 743-769 and 1852-1860). This is documentation only and no code is changed here. The new text describes a rollback that restores the retained predecessor through the watchdog's journaled rollback under the update lease, quarantines the installed release, and is not coordinator-contacting. This touches T-043 (watchdog rollback authority is the same replaceable provider binary), T-047 (downgrade), and T-013/T-034 (binary integrity and registered-hash checks). The next pass needs the implementing source (UpdateRollback.swift, SelfUpdater, and the watchdog code). It should check whether a rollback can reinstall a release that has since been revoked or de-registered, because no coordinator is contacted. It should also check whether the predecessor's hash and signature are re-verified before the swap, whether the restored build still has to pass App Attest qualification and the coordinator's registered-hash check before it can serve, whether the retained predecessor is protected from operator tampering, and whether `--yes` skips only the prompt. Unchanged base text only restates existing logout, sandbox installer (TB-013/T-061) and add-on hold (TB-012) behavior. I found no concrete regression visible in the supplied evidence, and I am not treating the missing head text as proof of safety.
